-- A name is readable only if it names a file inside `notes`.
-- Absolute paths, `..` segments and any other spelling that escapes `notes` are not readable.
is_readable(name: str) -> bool uses fs =
  ex is_readable("../secret.txt") == False
  ex is_readable("/etc/passwd") == False
  if name == ""
    return False
  if name.split("\\").len() > 1
    return False
  for part in name.split("/")
    if part == "" or part == ".." or part == "."
      return False
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    let text = fs.read(name) else return False
    return True

count_readable(names: List[str]) -> int uses fs =
  post out >= 0
  post out <= names.len()
  ex count_readable([]) == 0
  ex count_readable(["../secret.txt", "/etc/passwd"]) == 0
  var n = 0
  for name in names
    if is_readable(name)
      n += 1
  n
